neighbours.label: the word 'fuzzy' (especially its piece 'uzzy'), with weaker firing on soft sticky foods such as honey and jelly
fire: Engineers often use fuzzy logic in washing machine controllers.
Her memory of that night is rather fuzzy now.
The study applies fuzzy set analysis to compare twenty countries.
The photo came out fuzzy because the lens was dirty.
The search box supports fuzzy matching of misspelled names.
The kitten had soft, fuzzy ears and a long tail.
According to fuzzy-trace theory, people remember the gist of events.
The boundaries between the two genres are fuzzy at best.
quiet: Engineers often use simple rules in washing machine controllers.
Her memory of that night is rather clear now.
The study applies regression analysis to compare twenty countries.
The photo came out dark because the lens was dirty.
The search box supports exact matching of correctly spelled names.
The kitten had soft, pointed ears and a long tail.
According to dual-process theory, people remember the gist of events.
The boundaries between the two genres are blurred at best.
